paper_title: Spectrum of global string networks and the axion dark matter mass
suggested_experiment_name: Axion DM mass prediction (global string networks)
notes: This is a theoretical/numerical-simulation paper predicting the post-inflationary QCD axion dark matter mass from global string network simulations. Result is a predicted mass range m_a ~ 95-450 ueV (corresponding to a band on the f_a-m_a plane), not an experimental exclusion limit or sensitivity projection with extractable (mass, coupling) data points. No coupling-constant exclusion curve is presented as the main result; Fig 1 only shows other works' mass estimates overlaid on the C_agamma plane adapted from elsewhere. No tabulated numerical data extractable. | Vision: This is Figure 1, a composite axion-photon coupling (C_aγ, dimensionless) vs m_a plot adapted from a review. It overlays many experimental regions (CAST, Haloscopes, Globular clusters, etc.) and theory lines (KSVZ, DFSZ). The y-axis is C_aγ, NOT f_a, so this is not a clean AxionMass plot despite the text hint. The paper's main RESULT is a predicted DM mass range m_a ≈ 95-450 μeV (post-inflationary), shown as a band but not a coupling exclusion boundary. The traced boundary is approximate, following the dominant lower envelope of the excluded (colored) regions.
